quest.title: Dreamy Paititi
quest.description: You encounter a nursery full of blooming Brewblossoms in the wilderness of Tete Isle. It appears to be administered by a mysterious woman...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3, Easybreeze Badge x1

dialogues.text: Hmm... This bitter taste... Did I add too much Flamegrass?

choices.text: Hey there.

response.text: Glowing Hornshrooms... They need to be fermented first, then steamed twice. Hmm... The effect is still too weak...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Umm, is she just gonna keep ignoring us?

choices.text: Flamegrass?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Flower
dialogues.text: (A softly glowing flower bud sways at your touch, pulsing to some silent, secret rhythm...)
Hey! Hands off, please!

choices.text: I'm sorry.

response.text: You're quite polite. No wonder it doesn't dislike you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Look at the flower! Is it... dancing?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks more like... wriggling to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eww! Don't use such disgusting language on a flower! At least say it's "swaying" or something!
That's the "Dance of Erzulie." The flowers only react this way when someone with a strong affinity for clairvoyance draws near.
That's because Brewblossoms draw in spiritual energy from the land and produce a special nectar that heightens one's sensitivity to dreams.

Some people... Hmm, how should I put it? They're born with a natural spiritual affinity. So Brewblossoms, which absorb spiritual essence, are naturally more drawn to them. After all, legend says they're plants that act as a bridge between worlds.

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: By the way, I'm "Mad-Eye" Atzilli, a winemaker at the Me & Dew. And who might you be?

choices.text: #{M#I'm Svetlana Babushka, "Fist of the Beastly Ape."}{F#I'm Emmanuelle, the "Alloy Oakleg."}

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon's the "Soaring Hero," Hunter Gordon! Ah...

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: Pffft... Did you mean to introduce yourself with both names?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't call Paimon out! It's not like your name's any less weird!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Alright, enough joking! Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: #Paimon and {NICKNAME}, huh? You've got perfect timing! There's actually something I need your help with!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Anything to do with that... clairvoyance thing you talked about?

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: Ooh, sharp! Here, have a candy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! You're the best!

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: So here's the deal. I've been working on a brand-new drink for the Me & Dew. Mainly to help my clueless big sis pull in some fresh-faced, trend-chasing clientele.

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: And my latest project is... Well, it goes something like this...

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: "A dreamy, joy-sparking, zero-alcohol blend that lets ordinary folks feel a clairvoyance-adjacent sensation without getting tipsy or having to deal with a hangover!"

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: The key ingredient is a dollop of high-purity nectar from these Brewblossoms. But that's where the problem lies...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is the nectar not pure enough?

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: Bingo! Another candy for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon's on a roll today!

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: If only my affinity for clairvoyance were strong enough, I could spot the flaws instantly... But as it stands, all I can do is test and analyze the samples over and over again.

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: But thankfully, you showed up, and it looks like your affinity's much stronger than mine! Hehe, you might just be the answer to my prayers!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, what can I do to help?

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: First, drink this little bottle of nectar extract. Then I'll explain.

choices.text: It's worth a shot.

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: Here. Take this.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You down the nectar in one gulp. A strange sweetness, tinged with some putrid pungency, spreads through your body...\nLike a dream long forgotten, unraveling into damp, glimmering mist....

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The mist quickly clears, and your vision returns to normal.

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: See? Told you you'd be fine. Now let's get started!

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: There are three flower fields right outside. With your help, I'll be able to spot the tainted Brewblossoms in no time.

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: Follow me. I'll tell you about the tools we're going to use.

choices.text: Uhh... This stuff looks kinda suspicious...

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: Relax! Theoretically, the worst it can do is blind you!

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: And hey, if your affinity for clairvoyance is really that great, you'll be fine, even with a bad eye. You've got two, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, "eye" protest your ridiculous sense of logic!

response.speaker: Atzilli
response.text: Pfft, chill, chill! I'm just joking! You won't go blind. Probably.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can we just get started already?!

choices.text: #Hello, I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon's Paimon!

choices.text: It touched me first.

response.text: Heh, a smooth talker, huh? But... Hmm... It doesn't seem to dislike you.

dialogues.text: This one here is the "Dream Extractor," we can collect the purest pollen from the Brewblossoms.
First, we'll need to weed out the bad flowers. Those would be the ones tainted with impurities.
These plants have absorbed too much gunk from underground, and that messes with the effects and the safety of the drink.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how can we tell which ones are bad?
They'll react to people with special constitutions. I'm not sure how they'll react exactly, but I know that if you get close enough, the flower's bound to do something weird and obvious.
You'll see what I mean once we're in the flower fields.

talks.objective: Investigate the issue with the flower fields

dialogues.text: Let me see... Mm-hmm! The pollen in this Dream Extractor is super pure.
Perfect! Which means that last flower was definitely the contaminated one.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Mad Eye" Atzilli carefully pours the freshly gathered nectar into a tiny vial. Then, with practiced flair, she adds a few drops from other vials filled with brightly colored liquids...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A few minutes later...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Hmm... Judging by the sample, the purity's spot-on. No sign of any impurities or sediment. Excellent!
Let's power through and finish up the last two flower fields!

talks.objective: Investigate the issue with the flower fields

dialogues.text: Purrrr...
Meeeow?

choices.text: Whoa! A kitty!

response.text: Atzilli, what a two-faced witch you are! Did you start raising humans behind my back?
Ugh... Humans... Rude, filthy, stinking humans!
Didn't your mothers teach you how to treat a poor, lonely, free-spirited delicate flower like me...? *sniff*
*sniff* Anyway, I'm "Dambara the Pale," but you can just call me Dambara.

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: Face the wrath of my claws, foolish intruders! My fangs thirst for justice!

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: H—Hey! Why aren't you scared?! Am I not scary enough...? Tch...

choices.text: Easy, kitty. No need to go full beast-mode.

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: Ha! What's your game? Planning to hurt me? Steal my precious pollen?

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: ...Meeeow! You scoundrel!

choices.text: Begone, foul mirage!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You swing your sword at Dambara the Pale, and — Poof! The little cat vanishes...

choices.text: I'm not here to hurt you. I'm just... ignoring you.

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: Meow! I knew it you were out for my— Wait, what?

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: You didn't take any pollen? Or drink any nectar?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope. You've got too many weird impurities in your body.

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: Eh? Uhh... Hmm.

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: I... I see. Then I must've misunderstood. Sorry about that. If you're not going to hurt me, I won't hurt you either.

response.speaker: Dambara
response.text: Well then... Goodbye.

choices.text: Please stop. I'm so scared I'm about to cry.
You're just an illusion, aren't you? Guess I'll just have to get rid of you.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You swing your sword at Dambara the Pale, and — poof! The little cat vanishes...

choices.text: You can't fool me with an illusion. Taste my blade!

response.text: Meeeow!!!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You swing your sword at the illusion, and — poof! The little cat vanishes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Atzilli, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #There were three bad flowers in that field! But, umm... {NICKNAME} was acting a little strange. You're okay, right...?

choices.text: Yeah, I'm fine.

response.text: Hallucinations? Then there's no need to worry. It's common for Brewblossoms to release hallucinogenic pollen as a defense mechanism. They must've been especially reactive to you.
Paimon and I couldn't see what you were seeing because the pollen doesn't affect us the same way.
#But still... hmm. {NICKNAME}, are you experiencing any other symptoms?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope. Not yet, anyway...
All right. You know yourself best, but if anything starts to feel off, please let me know immediately.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then let's finish up the last field in one go!

choices.text: Just pollen-induced hallucinations. No big deal.

talks.objective: Investigate the issue with the flower fields

dialogues.text: Oink oink... Mmm... Oink oink...

choices.text: Let me guess — you can talk?

response.text: Oink oink?
Oink... oink...

choices.text: Oh? And why do you think that?

response.text: Oink oink... oink oink! Mmm, mmh... oink oink!

choices.text: I see... Do you have any family?

response.text: Oink oink...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem! Not to interrupt this... beautiful friendship, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's pretty sure the flower we're looking for is over there!

choices.text: Huh? What?

response.speaker: Innocent Piggy
response.text: Oink oink! Oink oink!

choices.text: This isn't another illusion!?
I also have one person I consider family.

response.text: Oink oink! Mmmph, mmph...!

choices.text: That's a sound argument. I concur!

response.text: Oink oink! Oink oink!

choices.text: I see... Do you have any family?
I also have one person I consider family.
#Hello, I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.text: Oink oink!

choices.text: You're an illusion, aren't you? Take this!

response.text: Oink oink?!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You swing your sword at the forest boar — It gives a loud squeal and then collapses...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Farewell, child of the stars! Should we not meet again in this nation... I shall await you in another..."\n

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Tarry not, oh tarry not..."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A dizzying wave rises with the thick, sticky sweetness of the flowers...\nBy the time your senses return, Paimon is already hovering nervously around you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, hey! Wake up! Are you alright? We found the flower!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You totally spaced out for a second there... Were you seeing stuff again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's use the Dream Extractor first. I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, as long as you're okay!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Atzilli! We found the weird flower you mentioned!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But... something's off with {NICKNAME}. Any ideas?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm fine, just a little lightheaded.
Did you see anything over there? Some kind of dangerous hallucination?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe the hallucination you saw to Atzilli...
The "Papa Witch Doctor's Prank"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's that?
It's an old tale passed down among shamans and brewers. They say Papa Witch Doctor guides the spirits of those who were unlucky and didn't die in glorious battle.
He's the kind of twisted spirit who treats fear like a game — always crafting eerie nightmares to toy with the living who catch his eye.
#Anyway... Ahem! Anyway, let me look you over, {NICKNAME}. You should be mostly fine.
#Hmm... Alright, no need to worry. Seems like {NICKNAME} just inhaled too much of the hallucinogenic pollen. You might feel dizzy for a bit, but it's nothing serious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I see...
But if any long lasting effects cause brain damage and drop your intelligence... Well, I'm afraid I can't help you with that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey!
Haha, just kidding! Now let me finish up the last step here.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Mad Eye" Atzilli carefully pours the freshly gathered nectar into a tiny vial. Then, with practiced flair, she adds a few drops from other vials filled with brightly colored liquids...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A few minutes later...
Let's see... Purities... Impure sediments... Toxicity levels... all within acceptable levels! Whoo! We're finally done!
Thanks so much for your help. Here's your reward!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! Thanks!
Ah, wait a moment! We're not done yet!
I'm about to start mixing my special "Sweet Dream Brew," and I'd love for you to come by and help me out with your clairvoyance again.
Looks like we might have results by tomorrow, so see you then! Who knows, maybe I'll even name the new drink after you!
I'll also answer those questions you had earlier, so don't forget to come over!

talks.objective: Talk to Atzilli and try out the "dream drink"

dialogues.text: Haha, remember that "Sweet Dream Brew" I mentioned? Well, I've got some great news for you!
After a full day of work, I've finally perfected the recipe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Congratulations!
Hehe, and you lucky two get to be my first customers! Don't worry about paying. I'll put it on my sister's tab!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yippee! Free drinks!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, hold on... You're just telling us we're your test subjects...
Of course! Aren't you honored?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not at all!

choices.text: I need to be sure this drink isn't dangerous.

response.text: Hmm? Oh, right... I did, didn't I...?
First off, I have to warn you — Brewblossom extract is highly toxic. But after repeated distillations, I've reduced the toxicity to a level that is tolerable for normal people.
By "tolerable," I mean to say that a normal person will "die" within about... Hmm, five seconds.
And when they "die," their soul will wander through a place where the mortal realm and the land of the dead overlap... I guess that's a good enough explanation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Which part of "die within five seconds" sounds "tolerable" to you!?

choices.text: So you're saying drinking it will kill me.

response.text: It's not a true death, per se, because your body will continue to function normally. Unless... you get so lost in the dreamscape that you forget to come back.
Then my sister and I would have to deal with a still-breathing corpse.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! So this isn't safe to drink at all, is it!?
Haha, don't you worry! Before y'all got here, I tested it out on myself.
Rest assured, I added Glowing Hornshrooms and the spiciest Brilliant Chrysanthemums I could get my hands on!
The Glowing Hornshroom lights the way for the soul back to the body, and the Brilliant Chrysanthemum's wicked kick snaps your senses awake, pulling you right back into, well, you.
So when you drink it, you won't even notice you've "died" once.
I'm not exaggerating. Trust me!
So? Wanna try? Or are you chicken?

choices.text: I'm not scared of something like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Then... give Paimon one too! No way {NICKNAME}'s going anywhere without her!
Haha, no worries — there's plenty for both of you! Here are your two cups of "Sweet Dream Brew."

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After a moment's hesitation, you drink the strange brew.\nThe flavor is wondrous yet bizarre, laced with latent spice and a faintly putrid tang...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: And then, a hazy dream...

choices.text: That's nothing. I've "died" more times than I can count.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph... give Paimon one too! She's not going to let you show off on your own!

choices.text: It's fine, Paimon! The worst that can happen is that... I... die?
You promised to explain the secret behind it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wah! Mi zido mita dada! Mmm~ Yaya dada! Movo dada!
Olah! Mosi mita yo! Sada mimi dada! Sada domu dada!

choices.text: Yo ya dala?

response.text: I'm your friend, and you're my friend! We're all good friends!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahaha! Mi zido mita dada!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sado! Yo beru mimi beru!?
Haha, what are you talking about? You're the one who started speaking our language!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sama! Mito! Ya upa dala?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ya upa dala?
Hehe, there's treasure up there! Let's go dig it up!
The treasure's right here! Let's share it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mimi Mani! Mimi mosi! Mimi muhe!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Mimi muhe!
Yay! Treasure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mosi mita! Mita dada! Hahahahahaha!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Unta dada, yoyo upa, nunu beru valo yoyo...

choices.text: Mi in dala?

response.text: Oh, you're in a happy place — a very happy place!

dialogues.text: So? How's my "Sweet Dream Brew"? Tasty?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ugh... Paimon's head hurts so bad... {NICKNAME}, are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We had a very strange dream...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We dreamed we were digging treasure... with Hilichurls?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... It's hard to explain... By the way, were we "dead" for a long time?
Yup, and I've been dead for a long time too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh?
Hahahaha! Just kidding! You were only out for a few seconds... I was worried it wouldn't work at all!
Good thing it did! Now, please tell me everything you saw in your dream — I'll write it all down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Uh... We'll try!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon piece together the bizarre dreamscape as "Mad-Eye" Atzilli listens intently, scribbling down notes.
Haha, that was great! It was total nonsense, but overall, what a fun dream it must have been!
But why hilichurls? That's strange...
Well, leave that mystery to me and my sister. Here's your reward!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... So you're really planning to sell this strange drink?
Oh, we're still a long way off from actually selling it. I still need to test it on more people with different constitutions.
Once you leave this place, you probably won't see our brew on shelves for quite a while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... That's a bit of a relief. Its effects are... kinda strong.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Strong and strange.
Pfft... Alright, alright, I get it!
Now that the experiment's over, you're free to go!
If you feel sick or experience any more side effects, do come find me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will do!
Hroooo... Woof! Woof, woof!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Briannus
dialogues.text: I am Sir Woofington Briannus, knight of this realm! Pray tell, what names do you bear?

choices.text: #Just call me {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: #Awoo~ Well met, {M#Sir}{F#Lady} {NICKNAME}! What brings you hither?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm looking for the flowers you're guarding.

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: As I feared. Alas, I have sworn on my blade to forbid outsiders from approaching my squire and maiden.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Squire and maiden... So there are two flowers?

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: Err, well... biologically speaking, each Brewblossom has both a stamen and a pistil, yes?

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: So... Technically, a single flower is both squire and maiden at the same time.

choices.text: Trying to distract me with biology? Not happening — En garde!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You swing your sword at Sir Briannus, and — poof! The big dog vanishes...

choices.text: That's... oddly progressive.

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: Woof! Did you just call flowers "progressive"? I'll have you know they predate the very concept!

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: #Well then, {M#Sir}{F#Lady} {NICKNAME}, it has been a pleasure. But my sworn duty calls — have at thee!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Sir Briannus challenges you to a duel. You swing your sword at the big dog, and — Poof! It vanishes...

choices.text: Good doggie, good doggie.

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: Wroo, rrooh! Woof, woof!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who's the goodest pet around?

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: Woof, woof!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's Paimon, of course!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Sir Briannus
response.text: You dare mock a knight to his face? I demand a duel!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Sir Briannus challenges you to a duel. You swing your sword at the big dog, and — Poof! It vanishes...
